relevance_definition: The corpus is unlabeled, so retrieved pairs are labelled by the Phase 3 logreg_head (test accuracy 0.6552, macro-F1 0.3032). A hit at rank <= k is a retrieved pair whose predicted label equals the opener's golden label. The classifier's noise is part of the measurement and is reported, not hidden; qualitative examples let a reader judge semantic similarity directly.

threshold_preview.note: Share of TEST openers whose top-1 cosine is at least the configured RETRIEVAL_THRESHOLD, and label-agreement recall among them — the grounding gate Phase 5/6 will consume. n=29, indicative only.
